Overall, Parting Shot into Gholdengo seems like the simplest reasonable play, letting it set up as a special attacker later despite the Ghost weakness risk.

The alternative is another Parting Shot to drop Rotom further and pivot, but that would bring in Gholdengo at only 12 HP, which is far too fragile to risk given Life Orb recoil could finish it off on its own.

Protect doesn't accomplish much here since it just lets Rotom heal and keep attacking. Flare Blitz remains the strongest play despite the resistance, since it's the only move putting real pressure on Incineroar's side of the field.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Rotom-Wash is low on HP with lowered Attack and Special Attack, while Incineroar still has decent HP left. Since Rotom outspeeds, I'm checking whether its weakened Hydro Pump can still do enough damage given the super-effective matchup against Incineroar's Fire typing and its solid Special Defense.

I'm weighing Protect as a safer option to stall and let leftovers chip Rotom back up, versus the risk that Incineroar's Flare Blitz—resisted but still powerful with STAB—could knock Rotom out at its current HP.

Parting Shot into Gholdengo seems risky too since water isn't resisted and it would just die to Hydro Pump at low HP. Protecting this turn seems safest, letting Rotom heal back up slightly, but it just delays the same decision next turn since Fake Out isn't an option here.

Flare Blitz only wins if Rotom doesn't pick Hydro Pump first, but given Rotom's pattern of choosing max-damage super-effective moves, Hydro Pump is the likely call and that would KO Incineroar before it can attack. So gambling on Flare Blitz looks like a loss more often than not, while Protect just wastes Rotom's Hydro Pump and resets the situation.

Parting Shot is another option—switching Incineroar out to bring in Gholdengo while weakening Rotom's offenses further, but then Rotom could just Hydro Pump the incoming Gholdengo and finish it off at 12 HP, so the move order matters a lot here.

Actually since Rotom outspeeds, if I use Parting Shot it just gets KO'd before switching out, so that line fails regardless. Flare Blitz is the best choice overall since it wins whenever Rotom doesn't go for Hydro Pump.

The bigger concern is whether Gholdengo even survives its own attack—Life Orb recoil costs 1/10 max HP, which at only 12 HP remaining could cause it to faint from its own move before Rotom even acts.

But Rotom outspeeds regardless, so it'll likely hit first with Hydro Pump or Thunderbolt and knock out Gholdengo either way. Given the -2 SpA drop makes a KO on Rotom unlikely, Shadow Ball is still the best choice for maximizing damage output before going down.
